title: Fire Erupts at Aramco Facility South of Riyadh as Houthi-Saudi Fighting Escalates
detail: A fire broke out at an Aramco oil facility south of the Saudi capital Riyadh as Saudi-Houthi fighting escalated, with flames and smoke visible at the site. Simultaneously, Houthis reported Saudi coalition airstrikes on Sanaa, marking a significant widening of strikes deep into Saudi territory and continuing tit-for-tat exchanges on both capitals.
